finding.details: Actual _entry call is protected by BaseException closure, but following transitions Counter update and pending/finished writes are outside the try. An injected BaseException after native return can leave unfinished state. Ordinary run propagates it; no actual replay was demonstrated.
finding.recommendation: Cover actual native entry plus post-return bookkeeping in the same terminal guard, and inject KeyboardInterrupt/MemoryError after the actual call in the existing lifecycle method. Do not inherit prior state source qualification after changing it.
